body: Automate This, ep. 2: reply to every enquiry in minutes. AI drafts it, you approve it.
An enquiry lands at 9pm. You see it two days later. They've already booked someone else.
The fix: n8n catches the form or email, AI drafts a reply from your real prices, FAQs and past replies, and you approve it on your phone in one tap. Nothing customer-facing goes out without you.
Slide 6 has the 4-step setup. Save it for the afternoon you build it.
